# LuminaNotes

## Overview
Vision-first OCR and academic summarization system. Processes PDFs, PPTX, and videos into Notion-ready study guides.

## Technology
Llama 4 Scout, Whisper, Python

## Source and scope
Reviewed 2026-10-12. Evidence classification: model_verified_other_details_owner_reported.
https://github.com/Qasim-Tahir/Lecture-Notes-Summarizer-OCR
No benchmark score, accuracy guarantee, or latency promise is asserted by this summary.

## Implementation
Book_processor.py configures meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct for vision extraction and summarization.
The project converts slides to PDF with LibreOffice, extracts page images with Poppler, and transcribes video audio with Whisper.
Entity checks compare names and other extracted entities with OCR text. Entity presence does not validate relationships, quantities, omissions, or factual accuracy.
